specs.Hardware Connectivity Technology: USB Type A, USB Type C

features: DUAL CONNECTOR, TYPE C + USB A: One OTG pendrive with a Type C connector for phones and tablets and a USB A connector for laptops and PCs. Move files without cables.
USB 3.2 GEN 1: Up to 150 MB/s read speed on USB 3.x ports for quick transfers of photos, videos and large files. Also works in USB 2.0 ports at USB 2.0 speed.
64GB STORAGE: Offload photos and videos from your phone and carry work or study files on one pen drive. Usable capacity is slightly lower than stated.
METAL BODY, WIDE COMPATIBILITY: Durable metal body for daily carry. Works with smartphones and tablets that support OTG, and with Windows laptops and PCs. Plug and play.
10 YEARS WARRANTY: Every unit is factory-tested for compatibility and stability before shipping, backed by Foxin's industry-leading 10-Years Warranty.
